main.description: Begin configuring a new MCP server for the org. Registers a Nango integration for it and returns a Nango Connect session token for the caller's browser: the caller enters the server's URL and completes authorization directly in Nango's Connect UI. Call completeAddServer once that succeeds, or cancelAddServer if the caller abandons it. Requires service-auth. Requires the mcp.configure action.

org.description: DID of the community to configure the server for.

name.description: Also becomes the server's record key and the namespace under which its tools are exposed. Letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores only, and must be unique within the org.

id.description: The new server's identifier (equal to name). Pass this to completeAddServer or cancelAddServer.

sessionToken.description: A Nango Connect session token, to be passed to the Nango frontend SDK's openConnectUI.
